details:
I’d like to suggest an improvement to VRChat’s screenmode interaction system.

Currently, there are situations where holding an item, such as a flashlight, prevents you from interacting with certain objects in a world. For example, a map might have teleport buttons or doors that can normally be interacted with, but the interaction becomes unavailable while I’m holding a flashlight.

It would be great if screenmode players could have the ability to interact with certain world objects while still holding an item. This could apply specifically to things such as doors, teleport buttons, switches, or other designated interactable objects.

For example:

Holding a flashlight → still being able to press a map teleport button

Holding an item → still being able to open a door

Holding an item → still being able to activate designated switches or buttons

I understand that this may need to depend on how the world creator has set up their interactable objects, but having an additional interaction option or system for these situations would make worlds much more convenient to navigate in screenmode.

This would be especially useful in worlds where players are expected to carry an item while simultaneously interacting with the environment.
title: Allow Screenmode Players to Interact With Map Objects While Holding Items
